import sys

def main():
    input_str = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    count = 0
    
    start = 0
    while start < len(input_str):
        current = input_str[start]
        end = start
        while end < len(input_str) and input_str[end] == current:
            end += 1
        run = end - start
        if run % 2 == 0:
            count += 1
        start = end
    
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
